subject: expression: simplify the code with the ExtractColumnsFromExpressions (#62825)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent: adds/uses new column-extraction helpers in `pkg/expression/util.go` (map/set/all-columns variants; `ContainCorrelatedColumn` becomes variadic) and updates planner callers in cardinality/selectivity, join reorder, FD/not-null extraction, and PB memtable predicate pushdown. Changes are refactors (plus a correctness-oriented switch to extract all column occurrences for PB predicates) and do not introduce Blocker/High issues in SQL semantics, correctness, or concurrency in the touched expression/planner paths.
